The Challenge 
Adsmagnify Academy was not looking to simply generate leads. 
The real objective was to build a repeatable student acquisition system that could 
consistently bring potential students into the Academy, nurture their interest and convert them 
into paid students. 
For a course business, the real journey is: 
Attention → Interest → Enquiry → Follow Up → Enrolment → Batch

So instead of depending on a single campaign, we built a structured Student Acquisition 
Funnel using Meta Ads. 
 
The Student Acquisition Funnel 
Our strategy was built around different stages of the student journey. 
01. AWARENESS 
Academy Engagement Campaign 
We introduced the Academy and its performance marketing education offering to the target 
audience. 
↓ 
02. CONSIDERATION 
Content & Engagement 
We used engagement campaigns to build familiarity and create a pool of people who had 
already interacted with the Academy. 
↓ 
03. REMARKETING 
Academy MOFU Remarketing 
People who had already shown interest were brought back into the funnel. 
↓ 
04. INTENT 
Academy Lead Generation 
High intent prospects were directed towards lead forms to enquire about the Academy. 
↓ 
05. CONVERSION

Sales Follow Up 
Leads were followed up and moved through the enrolment process. 
↓ 
06. ENROLMENT 
Paid Students 
Students joined the Academy and were allocated into batches.

April 1, 2026 to August 31, 2026 
Platform: Meta Ads

No agency, client acquisition, D2C or other campaigns have been included.

MIRAGE SPA × ADSMAGNIFY 
From 40 to 50 Annual Registrations 
How a high intent Google Ads strategy helped a Canadian 
beauty education institute generate 1,020 conversions 
and leads and grow its annual registration benchmark by 
25% 
 
EXECUTIVE SUMMARY 
Mirage Spa is a Canada based beauty and spa education institute offering professional training 
programs for aspiring beauty and wellness professionals. 
The institute operates in a high value education category where a single student represents 
CAD 11,000 in course revenue. 
When AdsMagnify began working on the acquisition strategy, the business had an annual 
registration target of:

40 STUDENTS 
The objective was not simply to generate website traffic. 
It was to create a predictable digital acquisition system capable of generating qualified enquiries 
and supporting student registrations. 
The strategy centered around Google Search, where prospective students could be reached 
while actively searching for relevant beauty education programs. 
The result was a measurable acquisition engine that generated: 
1,020 conversions and leads 
along with: 
12,663 clicks 
157,394 impressions 
and: 
CA$24,035.66 in advertising spend 
The business subsequently progressed from: 
40 registrations in 2024 
to: 
45 registrations in 2025 
and: 
50 registrations in 2026 
That represents: 
25% GROWTH IN ANNUAL 
REGISTRATIONS

At a CAD 11,000 course fee, the registration increase represents CAD 110,000 in additional 
annual tuition value compared with the 2024 baseline. 
 
ABOUT THE CLIENT 
Mirage Spa 
Mirage Spa is a Canadian beauty and spa education institute focused on professional training 
and career development within the beauty and wellness industry. 
The business operates in a category where prospective students typically require significant 
consideration before enrolling. 
A course valued at: 
CAD 11,000 
means that acquisition quality matters considerably. 
The business therefore needed more than visibility. 
It needed a system capable of consistently bringing prospective students into the admissions 
pipeline. 
 
THE BUSINESS OBJECTIVE 
The starting benchmark was straightforward: 
40 REGISTRATIONS PER YEAR 
The objective was to increase the number of students while creating a more measurable 
acquisition process.

Rather than measuring success only through impressions or clicks, the marketing strategy was 
built around a progression: 
Demand 
Capture people actively searching for beauty education. 
↓ 
Conversion 
Turn that intent into an enquiry. 
↓ 
Lead 
Generate a direct opportunity for the admissions team. 
↓ 
Registration 
Convert qualified prospects into students. 
This distinction was important. 
For a high ticket education business, traffic is not the end goal. Student acquisition is. 
 
THE CHALLENGE 
The problem was not simply generating traffic. 
People considering an CAD 11,000 education program are unlikely to make a decision 
immediately. 
They research different courses. 
They compare institutions. 
They search for specific specializations.

They evaluate their career options. 
They look for information before contacting the institute. 
This creates a fundamental acquisition challenge: 
How do you reach prospective students when their intent is highest? 
Our answer was to focus heavily on search intent. 
Instead of trying to convince completely cold audiences that they needed beauty education, the 
strategy focused on people already demonstrating an interest through their searches. 
 
THE ACQUISITION STRATEGY 
01. Capture Existing Search Demand 
Google Search was used as a primary acquisition channel because it allowed Mirage Spa to 
appear in front of prospects actively looking for relevant education and training opportunities. 
This created a fundamentally different environment from interruptive advertising. 
The prospect was already searching. 
The brand needed to be there. 
Don't create the intent. Capture it. 
 
COURSE SPECIFIC CAMPAIGN 
STRUCTURE 
The account included campaigns around different beauty education categories. 
These included: 
Esthetics

Nail Technology 
Eyelash Courses 
Beauty Courses 
The account also contained campaigns focused on Canadian markets and dedicated Mirage 
Spa campaigns. 
This structure allowed the acquisition strategy to respond to different areas of student demand 
rather than treating every prospective student as one generic audience. 
 
CONTINUOUS CAMPAIGN OPTIMIZATION 
The account was actively managed throughout the campaign period. 
Campaigns were not simply launched and left running. 
Different campaign structures were tested. 
Underperforming campaigns were paused. 
Some campaigns were removed. 
New campaigns were introduced according to changing requirements and performance. 
The 2025 account included multiple Search campaigns across different course categories. 
This created a continuous optimization cycle: 
Launch → Measure → Identify → Optimize → Scale 
The goal was to continuously improve the efficiency and quality of acquisition.
